Plan written. Reply 'yes' to build, or type what to change.

nodes.prompt:
Plans dir: the one the project AGENTS.md names, else docs/plans/.

Implement the newest *-plan.md in the plans dir, unit by unit, following the project AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md chain. Run each unit Verify step. If a reviewer or the build reported failures, fix those first. Do not commit. Reply with what changed per unit.

nodes.command: if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q "\"build\"" package.json; then if command -v bun >/dev/null; then bun run build; else npm run build; fi; else echo "no build script, skipped"; fi

nodes.prompt:
Plans dir: the one the project AGENTS.md names, else docs/plans/.

Review the uncommitted changes against the newest *-plan.md and *-requirements.md in the plans dir. Check every Success line and Done-when. Name each problem at file:line with the fix. PASS only if all are met.
